summary.result: From the result of inter-relationships among soil layers in terms of season and time lag, soil moisture change characteristics in the nut pine forest were upper soil layers were much sensitive than lowers, and seasonal variation if soil moisture for upper soil layers were bigger than lowers showing low correlation with precipitation in winter and spring due to freezing and snowfalls.
summary.background: Soil moisture was monitored to analyze soil moisture change characteristics in terms of time and soil layers in this study. 2 Years soil moisture change data was obtained from the experimental nut pine forest and statistical analysis including auto-correlation and cross-corelation among soil moisture data from different soil layers was conducted.
summary.method: Using the monitored soil moisture data, a relationship between soil moisture change and precipitation was analyzed and seasonal soil moisture change characteristics were analyzed.

summary_ko.background: 본 연구에서는 시기와 토층별 토양수분 변화 특성을 분석하기 위해 토양수분을 모니터링하였다.
summary_ko.method: 실험용 잣나무림에서 2년간의 토양수분 변화 데이터를 수집하여, 서로 다른 토층 간 토양수분 데이터의 자상관 및 교차상관을 포함한 통계분석을 수행하였다.
summary_ko.result: 계절 및 시간 지연에 따른 토층 간 상호관계 결과로부터 잣나무림의 토양수분 변화 특성을 파악하였으며, 상층부 토층은 하층부보다 훨씬 민감한 것으로 나타났다. 겨울과 봄에는 얼음과 눈이 내리는 영향으로 상층부 토양수분의 계절적 변동이 더 크며, 강수와의 상관성이 낮았다.
